gizmo.title: Mpaghara ntụba onyonyo
gizmo.description: Ndị mmụta na-etinye akara aha na mpaghara dị n'elu onyonyo, wee lelee azịza ha.

configure.title: Onyonyo
configure.description: Onyonyo ndị mmụta na-etinye akara aha na ya.

configure.title: Ederede nnọchi
configure.description: Na-akọwa onyonyo ahụ maka ndị na-enweghị ike ịhụ ya. Ekpughela ebe akara aha ga-aga.

configure.title: Aha onyonyo
configure.description: Aha dị mkpụmkpụ a na-ahụ anya maka onyonyo ahụ, e gosiri n'elu ya.

configure.title: Ajụjụ
configure.description: Ihe a na-ajụ ndị mmụta ka ha jiri akara aha mee.

configure.title: Akara aha na mpaghara
configure.description: Ihe ọ bụla bụ akara aha ndị mmụta nwere ike itinye. Nye akara aha aha mpaghara iji tinye mpaghara ya na onyonyo; akara aha na-enweghị aha mpaghara bụ nke ọzọ na-adịghị ebe ọ bụla. Ọnụọgụ mpaghara bụ pasentị nke onyonyo ahụ.

configure.title: Nkọwa onyonyo
configure.description: Nkọwa onyonyo nhọrọ e gosiri n'okpuru onyonyo ahụ.

advanced.title: Ngbalị
advanced.description: Ugboro ole onye mmụta nwere ike ilele. 0 pụtara enweghị oke.

advanced.title: Gwakọta akara aha
advanced.description: Gosi akara aha n'usoro dị iche oge ọ bụla a bịara.

advanced.title: Enwere ike ịkpachi
advanced.description: Gosi ajụjụ a dịka ahịrị na-emeghe ma na-emechi. Imeghe otu na-emechi ajụjụ ndị ọzọ enwere ike ịkpachi dị n'akụkụ ya.

advanced.title: Malite emechiri emechi
advanced.description: Mgbe enwere ike ịkpachi, malite dịka ahịrị emechiri emechi na-egosi naanị ajụjụ na ọnọdụ ya.

advanced.title: Ụdị akara
advanced.description: OER Schema: ụdị akara maka nyocha a (dịka akara, mkpụrụedemede, pasentị, mmecha).

advanced.title: Ebumnuche mmụta
advanced.description: OER Schema: ebumnuche mmụta metụtara nyocha a.

developer.title: Aha ajụjụ ule
developer.description: Aha ajụjụ ule e ji maka njirimara xAPI na sistemụ nyocha data.

developer.title: Ọmụmụ
developer.description: OER Schema: ọmụmụ e bu n'obi maka nyocha a.
